From 930a42ded3fede7ca3acafc9153f4f2d0f56a92c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexey Kardashevskiy <aik@ozlabs.ru>
Date: Tue, 7 Feb 2017 17:26:57 +1100
Subject: [PATCH] vfio/spapr_tce: Set window when adding additional groups to
 container

If a container already has a group attached, attaching a new group
should just program already created IOMMU tables to the hardware via
the iommu_table_group_ops::set_window() callback.

However commit 6f01cc692a16 ("vfio/spapr: Add a helper to create
default DMA window") did not just simplify the code but also removed
the set_window() calls in the case of attaching groups to a container
which already has tables so it broke VFIO PCI hotplug.

This reverts set_window() bits in tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw().

Fixes: 6f01cc692a16 ("vfio/spapr: Add a helper to create default DMA window")
Signed-off-by: Alexey Kardashevskiy <aik@ozlabs.ru>
Reviewed-by: David Gibson <david@gibson.dropbear.id.au>
Signed-off-by: Alex Williamson <alex.williamson@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/vfio/vfio_iommu_spapr_tce.c b/drivers/vfio/vfio_iommu_spapr_tce.c
index 7690e5bf3cf1..59b3f62a2d64 100644
--- a/drivers/vfio/vfio_iommu_spapr_tce.c
+++ b/drivers/vfio/vfio_iommu_spapr_tce.c
@@ -1245,6 +1245,8 @@ static void tce_iommu_release_ownership_ddw(struct tce_container *container,
 static long tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw(struct tce_container *container,
 		struct iommu_table_group *table_group)
 {
+	long i, ret = 0;
+
 	if (!table_group->ops->create_table || !table_group->ops->set_window ||
 			!table_group->ops->release_ownership) {
 		WARN_ON_ONCE(1);
@@ -1253,7 +1255,27 @@ static long tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw(struct tce_container *container,
 
 	table_group->ops->take_ownership(table_group);
 
+	/* Set all windows to the new group */
+	for (i = 0; i < IOMMU_TABLE_GROUP_MAX_TABLES; ++i) {
+		struct iommu_table *tbl = container->tables[i];
+
+		if (!tbl)
+			continue;
+
+		ret = table_group->ops->set_window(table_group, i, tbl);
+		if (ret)
+			goto release_exit;
+	}
+
 	return 0;
+
+release_exit:
+	for (i = 0; i < IOMMU_TABLE_GROUP_MAX_TABLES; ++i)
+		table_group->ops->unset_window(table_group, i);
+
+	table_group->ops->release_ownership(table_group);
+
+	return ret;
 }
 
 static int tce_iommu_attach_group(void *iommu_data,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/vfio/vfio_iommu_spapr_tce.c`**
1. **Function Update**: The function `tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw` has been modified to include logic for setting windows when attaching additional groups to a container that already has groups attached.
2. **New Logic**: 
   - A loop has been added to iterate over the maximum number of tables (`IOMMU_TABLE_GROUP_MAX_TABLES`), where it calls `set_window` for each table in the container that is not null.
   - If `set_window` fails for any table, it will call `unset_window` for all previously set tables and then call `release_ownership` to clean up.
3. **Error Handling**: The function now includes error handling to ensure that if setting a window fails, it properly releases ownership and cleans up.

### Relationships
The modifications in the patch are aimed at restoring functionality that was lost due to a previous commit (identified by the fix reference). The previous commit simplified the code but inadvertently removed the necessary `set_window` calls when attaching new groups to a container that already had IOMMU tables. This patch reintroduces those calls, ensuring that the VFIO PCI hotplug functionality works correctly by properly managing the IOMMU tables associated with the container. The changes ensure that the system can handle multiple groups being attached to a container without losing the ability to set the appropriate DMA windows.

Here is the commit message:
vfio/spapr_tce: Set window when adding additional groups to
 container

If a container already has a group attached, attaching a new group
should just program already created IOMMU tables to the hardware via
the iommu_table_group_ops::set_window() callback.

However commit 6f01cc692a16 ("vfio/spapr: Add a helper to create
default DMA window") did not just simplify the code but also removed
the set_window() calls in the case of attaching groups to a container
which already has tables so it broke VFIO PCI hotplug.

This reverts set_window() bits in tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw().

Fixes: 6f01cc692a16 ("vfio/spapr: Add a helper to create default DMA window")
Signed-off-by: Alexey Kardashevskiy <aik@ozlabs.ru>
Reviewed-by: David Gibson <david@gibson.dropbear.id.au>
Signed-off-by: Alex Williamson <alex.williamson@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the `set_window` calls in the `tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw` function when attaching new groups to a container that already had IOMMU tables. This change, made in a previous commit, simplified the code but broke the functionality required for VFIO PCI hotplug, as it prevented the proper programming of IOMMU tables to the hardware.

Here is the patch:
 
 static long tce_iommu_take_ownership_ddw(struct tce_container *container,
 		struct iommu_table_group *table_group)
 {
+	long i, ret = 0;
+
 	if (!table_group->ops->create_table || !table_group->ops->set_window ||
 			!table_group->ops->release_ownership) {
 		WARN_ON_ONCE(1);
 		return -EFAULT;
 	}
 
 	table_group->ops->take_ownership(table_group);
 
+	/* Set all windows to the new group */
+	for (i = 0; i < IOMMU_TABLE_GROUP_MAX_TABLES; ++i) {
+		struct iommu_table *tbl = container->tables[i];
+
+		if (!tbl)
+			continue;
+
+		ret = table_group->ops->set_window(table_group, i, tbl);
+		if (ret)
+			goto release_exit;
+	}
+
 	return 0;
+
+release_exit:
+	for (i = 0; i < IOMMU_TABLE_GROUP_MAX_TABLES; ++i)
+		table_group->ops->unset_window(table_group, i);
+
+	table_group->ops->release_ownership(table_group);
+
+	return ret;
 }
